name: phone-note
description: A plain phone-notes list on a paper sheet that grows name by name: title line, then each item is written in turn (stagger) and the sheet lengthens (final size is reserved, nothing shifts). Optional per-item `strike:true` draws a red-pen scratch-out; optional `total` line at the end in big type with a blue underline. totalAt (s after the cut; default -1 = next in sequence) writes the total on a chosen word; grow (default true) makes the paper fit only the rows written so far while an invisible ghost reserves the final layout; grow:false shows the full-size paper from the start. Params: title, items [{text, strike}], stagger (0.35), total.
